## Checklist

- [ ] Title uses Conventional Commits (`feat`, `fix`, `chore`, `docs`, `test`, `ci`, `refactor`)
- [ ] `scripts/verify.sh lint` passes
- [ ] Backend unit tests pass, if the API changed
- [ ] Frontend unit tests pass, if the UI changed
- [ ] `backend/openapi.json` and `frontend/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts` are updated, if the API changed
- [ ] Playwright journeys pass, if a user flow changed
